notes.title: 1.0.1.3 is OUT! Spine 3.8 Support!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243901/cad2c938745a1b00520c0813dc615f0b44953970.png[/img]
Now you will be able to import and export your Spine 3.8 files.
However, there are some limitations for now:

[list]
[*]   Graphs in your existing animations in the Spine file must be linear. Curves should not be used.
[*]    There should be no keys for slot color or alpha in your Spine file.  
[/list]

These are temporary limitations that you need to be aware of for a short time. I will provide full support in the next version.

Also, please share any errors and bugs . This feature is currently in the testing phase.

notes.title: 1.0.1.2 is OUT!! Faster Spine Json export
notes.content:
[b]- Faster JSON Export :[/b] Previously, as the number of animations in the JSON file increased, exporting a new animation took a very long time. Now, it is much faster than before...
[b]-Background music :[/b] Adding background music makes it easier to synchronize your animations with the music. Supported formats: all formats supported by FMOD (wav, ogg, mp3 ...)

notes.title: 1.0.1.1 is OUT! FBX Import bug fixed
notes.content: Previously, after importing an FBX file, when you pressed the import button and canceled it, FBX2Spine would crash. Fixed.
